4510.name: Calm Before the Storm
desc: Bring the Bank Voucher to Idriana in the bank of Darnassus.
objectives: Bring the Bank Voucher to Idriana in the bank of Darnassus.
details: $N, your help has been immeasurable. The time will come, no doubt, when I'll ask for your assistance against the silithid once more. We must absorb what we have learned in Un'Goro; I fear that my assumptions that the silithid originated from Un'Goro are now wrong... that indeed there is a far stronger presence somewhere.
Take this note to Idriana at the bank. She'll give you something from my vault that should be viewed as a token of my gratitude. Thank you for your assistance, brave $c.
completion: This bank voucher authorizes me to withdraw an item from Gracina Spiritmight's account with us and present it to you. Congratulations would seem to be in order!

4606.name: The Sparklematic 5200!
completion: As quickly as it started, the Sparklematic 5200 comes to an abrupt halt. A simple "ding" is heard from the machine, and the mouth of the machine spirals upward. Inside the Sparklematic 5200 is a small box wrapped in a little bow. The machine would appear to wrap an object up after eliminating its grime-encrusted status. Even if the machine didn't work, at least the item is now wrapped in a pretty box.
Well, there is one way to find out if it cleaned the item or not...

4726.name: Broodling Essence
desc: Bring 8 Broodling Essence and the Draco-Incarcinatrix 900 to Tinkee Steamboil at the Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.
objectives: Bring 8 Broodling Essence and the Draco-Incarcinatrix 900 to Tinkee Steamboil at the Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.
details: I have been studying the dragonkin of the Burning Steppes for weeks, and I think I've finally had a breakthrough! I created a device--I call it the Draco Incarcinatrix 900. It can capture the essence of dragon whelp broodlings!
Or, at least I think it can.
Here, take the device and zap a broodling in the Burning Steppes with it. While it's under the device's effects, defeat the broodling and its essence should be released.
If it is, then splendid! Bring me back samples so I can study them!
completion: It worked! You got the essence! Well done, $N! Well done!

This essence will be invaluable in my research. I hope to one day learn how to capture living dragons whelps, or perhaps capture their eggs. If I could find a way to do that, then I would be the envy of dragon scholars around the world!
My employer would also be happy, and as I said before, he's someone you want to keep happy...

4822.name: You Scream, I Scream...
desc: Get some Strawberry Ice Cream for your ward. The lad seems to prefer Tigule and Foror's brand ice cream.
objectives: Get some Strawberry Ice Cream for your ward. The lad seems to prefer Tigule and Foror's brand ice cream.
details: ICE CREAM! Oh please please please could you get me some ice cream?! Strawberry is my favorite flavor, and there's no better strawberry ice cream in the world than Tigule and Foror's Strawberry Ice Cream! It's my favorite ice cream in the whole wide world!

I had it once a long time ago when I was at the Shimmering Flats race track, but I heard that they might be selling them in town now! Please? Pretty please? With Tigule and Foror's Strawberry Ice Cream on top??!?!
completion: Mmmmmmmmm! I love their strawberry ice cream! If there's one thing Tigule and Foror know to do, it's make ice cream!
Thank you very much $N - this is the best treat ever!

4966.name: Protect Kanati Greycloud
desc: Protect Kanati Greycloud from the centaur attack.
objectives: Protect Kanati Greycloud from the centaur attack.
details: But, there may be more centaur than I thought, I ask you, $n, to fight with me against these vile assassins.
completion: Thank you for your help, $N. I couldn't have held them off without you.

5062.name: Sacred Fire
desc: Gather 10 bushels of Incendia Agave, and then consult Magatha Grimtotem on Elder Rise in Thunderbluff.
objectives: Gather 10 bushels of Incendia Agave, and then consult Magatha Grimtotem on Elder Rise in Thunderbluff.
details: Arikara is a deadly creature that must be dealt with swiftly. In order to hunt her down you will need to light the sacred fire of life - this will summon Arikara.

Go now and harvest the rare Incendia agave plant. Once you have harvested enough agave, seek council with Magatha Grimtotem on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. She is a powerful shaman that can enchant the agave plant to create a powder that will light the fire.
Travel northeast to the Boiling Pool and gather Incendia Agave.
completion: Good, you have gathered the essential amount of Incendia agave. This rare herb found only in Thousand Needles will help light the dormant sacred fire of life.
B<Magatha begins to enchant the Incendia agave.>

5086.name: Toxic Horrors
desc: Collect 3 Toxic Horror Droplets for Donova Snowden in Winterspring.
objectives: Collect 3 Toxic Horror Droplets for Donova Snowden in Winterspring.
details: I've studied the sample you returned with, and while I can't say for sure, I believe it contains traces of toxic elements. However, the only way to know for sure is to gather some as a comparison.
I believe that the Deadwood furbolg may be gathering these elements from other corrupted creatures in Felwood; in particular, the elementals living in the Irontree Woods, called toxic horrors.
Collect a few samples for me to compare, but be careful -- it's very dangerous there!
completion: I have to compare this to the substance you found in the cauldron, and then I'm sure we'll know more.

5158.name: Seeking Spiritual Aid
desc: Take the Corrupt Moon Well Water to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.
objectives: Take the Corrupt Moon Well Water to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.
details: Take the corrupt water to the Barrens, $N. South of Ratchet, hidden along the shore, is an old friend of mine, a shaman named Islen Waterseer. She is a powerful shaman who will help us. Her relationship with the spirits of water has always been strong. Our task being a noble one should be enough to persuade her and the spirits of water to aid us in this task.
You should find her at a small camp right along the water's edge. And, $N, ignore the pirates... they are but a nuisance and no threat to you.
completion: Ah, you need the water from this Moon Well cleansed. Stopping this force of malice in Felwood seems noble enough, but it is not for me to decide if the water will be purified. I will ask the spirits of water--it will be up to them to decide if the cause is just.
Give me a moment and I will tell them of your plea. I hope they are as sympathetic as I am to your cause.

5206.name: Marauders of Darrowshire
desc: Bring 5 Resonating Skulls and the Mystic Crystal to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.
objectives: Bring 5 Resonating Skulls and the Mystic Crystal to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.
details: Chromie said the relics you gathered are reagents to a powerful spell, and one more is required: skulls from the scourge who took part in the battle of Darrowshire.

Take this crystal and hunt scourge champions for their skulls. The crystal is enchanted; if a champion took part in the battle, then when you pass the crystal over its skull it will resonate. Bring me those resonating skulls.
Go, $N. You'll find scourge champions in the Noxious Glade to the north and the Fungal Vale to the west.
completion: You found them! Wonderful!
Although I don't fully understand how they can help us, I feel their power and I know in my bones that they are linked to my home village of Darrowshire.

5230.name: Return to the Bulwark
desc: Bring the Filled Felstone Field Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
objectives: Bring the Filled Felstone Field Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
details: You fill the bottle with enough of the cauldron's poisonous concoction for a suitable sample to be studied.
With the poison in hand, it is time to return to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark to complete the mission.
completion: Well done $N - it should take Apothecary Dithers no time at all to analyze this and devise a counter agent to introduce into the cauldron. If we are able to pump out enough of it into the air, we might be able to weaken all the Scourge present here.

This will no doubt be an ongoing ordeal; we will need to continually hit these cauldrons and introduce our reagents into their mix. Still, if we can keep it up, we will have a huge advantage over Scourge when the time comes for battle!

5302.name: The Way of the Weaponsmith
desc: To become a Weaponsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Borgosh: 4 Moonsteel Broadswords, 4 Massive Iron Axes, 2 Heavy Mithril Axes, and 2 Big Black Maces.
objectives: To become a Weaponsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Borgosh: 4 Moonsteel Broadswords, 4 Massive Iron Axes, 2 Heavy Mithril Axes, and 2 Big Black Maces.$B
details: One day, I will create a legendary hammer. A hammer fit for a Warchief!
It is my life's work, $N. My passion. I recognize that you have the potential to be among us, one of us - a weaponsmith. I am the one that can help you harness that potential.
BA simple task is all that you must complete. Simple for one of your exceptional skill.
completion: This is the final step before you begin your new career as a weaponsmith, $N. Should you choose to back out, now would be your last chance. Otherwise, prepare to be consumed by knowledge!

5518.name: The Gordok Ogre Suit
desc: Bring 4 Bolts of Runecloth, 8 Rugged Leather, 2 Rune Threads, and Ogre Tannin to Knot Thimblejack. He is currently chained inside the Gordok wing of Dire Maul.
objectives: Bring 4 Bolts of Runecloth, 8 Rugged Leather, 2 Rune Threads, and Ogre Tannin to Knot Thimblejack. He is currently chained inside the Gordok wing of Dire Maul.
details: If you're going to fight the king of this dump - and I think that's what you're bound to do - then you're going to need to get by Captain Kromcrush. Now, you can get by him by killing him, sure. You might actually want to leave him alive.

How, you ask? Since I've been here, I think I know how to make an ogre suit that will last just long enough to fool these bozos. The only problem is stability - ten minutes tops. Bring me what I need, and I'll make you one. I'm not going anywhere...
completion: Yeah, this will do the trick. Just a slip here, and tuck here... heh - this is going to work out just fine! <A broad smile beams from the chained goblin's face.>

Here you go, you're all set. Remember- this isn't the most securely fashioned item in the world. You'll have ten minutes of use before it falls apart, and then you're not going to fool anybody! Try using it just before you approach him, and remember... it only will make him think that YOU are an ally - not your group mates!

5542.name: Demon Dogs
desc: Slay 20 Plaguehound Runts, 5 Plaguehounds and 5 Frenzied Plaguehounds. Return to Tirion Fordring when the task is complete.
objectives: Slay 20 Plaguehound Runts, 5 Plaguehounds and 5 Frenzied Plaguehounds. Return to Tirion Fordring when the task is complete.
details: If you are going to remain here, I ask only that you earn your keep. We have many nuisances that could use some 'discipline.'
You can start with the Plaguehounds and their runts.
I cannot offer much in return, but you are guaranteed a warm meal and some conversation should you succeed.
completion: Well done, $N. Come. Rest. Let us eat and talk of days long past!

5638.name: Desperate Prayer
desc: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
objectives: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
details: Just a short time ago, one of your priests was here looking for you, $r. He said that if I were to see you, I should direct you towards the Cathedral of Light. He said it was very important, but I would not be overly concerned if I were you. His demeanor seemed positive... as though it were good news. I wouldn't take too long in making my way there if I were you.
Elune be with you, good $r.
completion: I'm glad you've arrived, $N. There are many things we will have to discuss, but more importantly is your training in the ways of the Light.
There are lessons all servants of the Light must learn. If you are ready, we'll begin discussing some of those now.

5662.name: Touch of Weakness
desc: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.
objectives: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.
details: My respect to you and your kind, $N. I normally teach only those of my own tribe. Your lessons come from Aelthalyste in the city once called Lordaeron.
You should return to her if you're to learn those abilities that set you apart from other faiths.
Go to the War Quarter in the Undercity and find your mistress there.
completion: Ah, good, another has arrived. Time may not matter to me, but to you it is of the essence. There is much for you to learn and there is much I wish to teach you. You simply must prove your worth. Do that, and you shall be greatly rewarded.

5902.name: A Plague Upon Thee
desc: Find someplace suitable in the center of the Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands to place the Barrel of Plagueland Termites.
objectives: Find someplace suitable in the center of the Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands to place the Barrel of Plagueland Termites.
details: Now that we have plenty of termites, take this steel reinforced barrel to the Northridge Lumber Mill south of Hearthglen--you'll find it to the west of the road that leads you up to the town.
Once there, place the barrel in the center of the lumber mill; someplace high, like on a crate or something.
After you open it, the rest should take care of itself. Just come back here and I'll reward you for helping me.
completion: The termites are obviously getting restless as you place the barrel on top of the crate.

5926.name: Heeding the Call
desc: Speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff.
objectives: Speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff.
details: Excuse me, friend...

It has come to my attention that Turak Runetotem has put out word that he wishes to speak with you. It seems that your training as a druid is about to take on a new life, and he will be training you personally. Turak is one of the Arch Druid's assistants; he is known as a wise and patient druid, and he should teach you well.
He is located in Thunder Bluff, inside the Cenarion Circle's main tent on the Elder Rise.
completion: I am glad you found your way here today. young $C. The time has come for you to take a large step into a much larger world.

Inside each of Cenarius' children is the call to serve nature. Animals and plants are our friends as well as our charges. We choose to devote our lives as preservers of balance for their sakes as well as our own. Your first step into this world will be to learn of the ways of the bear, and to learn strength of body and heart.
Ready yourself!

6022.name: To Kill With Purpose
desc: Travel to Corin's Crossing to the east and slaughter the Scourge that inhabit the town. Collect 7 pieces of Living Rot in under 10 minutes. Use the Mortar and Pestle to grind the Living Rot into Coagulated Rot.
objectives: Travel to Corin's Crossing to the east and slaughter the Scourge that inhabit the town. Collect 7 pieces of Living Rot in under 10 minutes. Use the Mortar and Pestle to grind the Living Rot into Coagulated Rot.
details: You kill with purpose while you remain on my stead.
Your first task is to feed my hounds.

Take this mortar and pestle and travel to Corin's Crossing. Once there, you will find a robust selection of Scourge to slaughter. From their fresh carcasses I need living rot. Take that living rot and grind it up in the mortar, then let it sit to coagulate. Bring the coagulated rot back here.
And imbecile, realize that living rot from the undead doesn't remain 'living' for very long. You must kill quickly!
completion: Disappointing. I was hoping that I'd be feeding you to my hounds, instead.
B<Nathanos sighs.>
Well, at least you they'll have something to eat.

6070.name: The Hunter's Path
desc: Speak with Thotar at Razor Hill.
objectives: Speak with Thotar at Razor Hill.
details: Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.
You must see Thotar at Razor Hill. He can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.
completion: Yes, it is time for you to begin your training.

6142.name: Clam Bait
desc: Find 10 pieces of Soft-shelled Clam Meat and bring it back to Mai'Lahii at Shadowprey Village.
objectives: Find 10 pieces of Soft-shelled Clam Meat and bring it back to Mai'Lahii at Shadowprey Village.
details: You have the look of a fisherman, $c! I love to fish - been fishing all my life. The best bait to use is soft-shelled clam meat; the fish just can't resist, you know what I mean?

Up north you will find a wrecked ship off the coast. Soft-shelled clams are littered throughout the area. If you bring me back 10 pieces of soft-shelled clam meat, I will give you something in return.
completion: Perfect mon, this is just what the witch doctor told me to do for my headache. He says, ""Mai'Lahii - go fish. It'll make you feel better""
Well, I feel better already, thanks mon!

6382.name: The Ashenvale Hunt
desc: Speak with Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.
objectives: Speak with Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.
details: Your strength impresses me, $c. Your willingness to embrace the hunt gives me confidence that you could move on to bigger game... and bigger challenges.

The forests of Ashenvale represent a vast untamed wild that the Horde seeks to impose its own will upon, both politically and spiritually. If you seek to prove yourself in an unproven land, seek the guidance of Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post. The outpost is due north of the path leading from the Barrens.
completion: Welcome to the new frontier, $N. Ashenvale is a land of opportunity, one where a young $C like yourself is able to find boundless chances to prove their mettle. Look around the outpost here, and be sure to travel out to the Zoram Strand, as the Horde has another outpost there as well.
Your presence here tells me that you've come to learn more about the hunt. Listen close, and I will gladly share with you what you need to know.

6502.name: Drakefire Amulet
desc: You must retrieve the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion from General Drakkisath. Drakkisath can be found in his throne room behind the Halls of Ascension in Blackrock Spire.
objectives: You must retrieve the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion from General Drakkisath. Drakkisath can be found in his throne room behind the Halls of Ascension in Blackrock Spire.
details: It is a piece of the dragon; a scale - enchanted and transformed. Whole, it could have granted access to the beast's lair. Shattered, it is useless.

It is possible to repair the item, but to do so would require the blood of a black dragon champion. There is one... He is known as General Drakkisath, ruler of the dragonspawn armies of Nefarian. Perhaps you have heard of him?
Return with his blood, $r, and I shall enchant the fragment into something that will grant you access to Onyxia's lair.
completion: This amulet will grant you the access that you seek. The lair of Onyxia can be found in Dustwallow Marsh. As long as you hold the amulet, her wards cannot prevent you from entering.
The Blue Flight wishes you luck, $N.

6622.name: Triage
desc: Save patients by using Triage Bandages to tend to their wounds. You must save 15 patients before 6 of them die from their injuries.

Remember the order of triage! Critically Injured Soldiers die the fastest followed by Badly Injured Soldiers. Injured Soldiers take the longest to die and should be saved AFTER your Critically Injured and Badly Injured Soldiers have been triaged.
objectives: Save patients by using Triage Bandages to tend to their wounds. You must save 15 patients before 6 of them die from their injuries.

Remember the order of triage! Critically Injured Soldiers die the fastest followed by Badly Injured Soldiers. Injured Soldiers take the longest to die and should be saved AFTER your Critically Injured and Badly Injured Soldiers have been triaged.
details: Good day, doctor. You will be tested on your ability to triage patients accordingly this afternoon. Should you pass your examination, you will join the prestigious ranks of Horde Trauma.

Now pay attention! The critically injured must be tended to first. After the criticals come the badly injured. The injured should be tended to last. You must save 15 patients to pass this exam. You will fail should 6 of your patients die in triage.
Triage bandages will be supplied.
Good luck, doctor.$B
completion: Doctor $N, welcome to Horde Trauma.

6646.name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Blood of the Mountain

6862.name: Zinfizzlex's Portable Shredder Unit
desc: null

6982.name: Coldtooth Supplies
desc: Bring 10 Coldtooth Supplies to the Alliance Quartermaster in Dun Baldar.

7102.name: Towers and Bunkers
desc: Destroy the banner at an enemy tower or bunker, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.
objectives: Destroy the banner at an enemy tower or bunker, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.
details: Towers and bunkers are key defensive positions, and so we must hold as many as possible! I want you to attack a tower or a bunker in Alterac Valley.
To do that, enter a tower with a Horde banner atop it. You will see another enemy banner inside. Pull out that banner, and a white Alliance banner will appear in its place. Well done!
At that point your mission for me will be complete, but hold the area long enough, and if the Horde doesn't take it back, then it will be destroyed!
completion: I received a field report stating you helped secure an enemy banner. Well done, $N! With their ranged troops out of position we can move the line of battle forward!

7222.name: Speak with Voggah Deathgrip
desc: Speak with Voggah in Frostwolf Keep.
objectives: Speak with Voggah in Frostwolf Keep.
details: A $c? Good! We are glad to see you in Alterac, $N. Interloping dwarves and their allies invade our valley, and we welcome all in the Horde to join us in righteous slaughter!
Speak with Voggah Deathgrip. He is looking for agents for an important mission into the Alliance's stronghold in Alterac Valley!
You will find Voggah in Frostwolf Keep.

7366.name: The Archbishop's Mercy
desc: You have been tasked with slaying opposing Forsaken players in Alterac Valley.
Kill a Forsaken and return to Commander Karl Philips (who wanders between the lumber mill and the mine) with a Forsaken Heart.
objectives: You have been tasked with slaying opposing Forsaken players in Alterac Valley.
Kill a Forsaken and return to Commander Karl Philips (who wanders between the lumber mill and the mine) with a Forsaken Heart.
details: The Archbishop is as kind as he is wise. For a man to look mercifully on such a wretched lot...
B<Commander Philips shakes his head in disbelief.>
Too kind... Just too kind.
The Archbishop asks that we take pity on the undead and grant them swift and permanent deaths. For this grand display of mercy, we merely require their black, disease ridden hearts.
Bring me the hearts of the Forsaken so that they may be ceremoniously incinerated at the Cathedral of Light. Make haste, $N!
completion: Praise be to Benedictus! Another lost soul, soon to be saved by the white hot flames of the Light!
Go ye, oh soldier of Light! More must be saved!

7462.name: The Treasure of the Shen'dralar
desc: Return to the Athenaeum and find the Treasure of the Shen'dralar. Claim your reward!
objectives: Return to the Athenaeum and find the Treasure of the Shen'dralar. Claim your reward!
details: In the library, Athenaeum, you will find an ancient chest hidden beneath the stairway. Take from it that which you desire.
completion: You open the chest to find...

7486.name: A Hero's Reward
desc: Claim your reward from Hydraxis' Coffer.
objectives: Claim your reward from Hydraxis' Coffer.
details: $N, your services to the Warlords surpassed all we could expect from the denizens of this world.
We do not understand your people's notions of gratitude, or rewarding good works, but in this case... perhaps a reward is warranted.
Under the surf at the southern base of this island, you will find a coffer. In it you will find your... reward.
Go, $N. Claim your reward.
completion: Hydraxis' voice descends from the waters' surface...
B"Choose that which best suits you, $N. May it protect you against the foes of the Waterlords."

7582.name: The Prison's Casing
desc: Travel to Darkwhisper Gorge in Winterspring and recover 5 Tears of the Hederine from the Hederine demons that occupy the gorge. Return to Daio in the Tainted Scar when you have completed this task.
objectives: Travel to Darkwhisper Gorge in Winterspring and recover 5 Tears of the Hederine from the Hederine demons that occupy the gorge. Return to Daio in the Tainted Scar when you have completed this task.
details: The Hederine demons that occupy the foothills of Mount Hyjal secrete powerful fel poisons, which if left to mature, harden into a dense anti-magic crystal. These crystals have come to be known as Tears of the Hederine.
Not even the immense power of a Doomguard could break the walls of a prison constructed from this material.
Travel to Darkwhisper Gorge in Winterspring and recover the Tears.
completion: I merely need to combine the blood of the Wildspawn with these crystals and the prison shall be ready for use.

7630.name: Arcanite
desc: Bring 3 Arcanite Bar to Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes.
objectives: Bring 3 Arcanite Bar to Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes.
details: Now that the Bell, Wheel and Candle are made, I should make a black lodestone. During your ritual, you'll need that lodestone to maintain the other ritual objects if they should fail.
To make the lodestone, I require arcanite. Do you have any? If not, then... you'll have to get the arcanite from an alchemist.
Return to me when you have the arcanite, and then I'll make the black lodestone.
completion: You got it! Nicely done! Now I can create the lodestone. When you're finally ready for your ritual to create the Circle of Greater Summoning, you'll want a lodestone to make sure the ritual doesn't fizzle out!

7654.name: Imperial Plate Boots
objectives: {'type': 'item', 'id': 12359, 'target': 'Thorium Bar', 'text': None}
completion: A pleasure doin' business with ya.
And $N, wipe that look of disgust off yer face.

7726.name: Refuel for the Zapping
desc: Collect 6 Water Elemental Cores from the Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays along the Forgotten Coast of Feralas, and bring them back to Zorbin Fandazzle who is near the dock there.

7798.name: A Donation of Silk
objectives: {'type': 'item', 'id': 4306, 'target': 'Silk Cloth', 'text': None}
completion: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, $N!

7822.name: A Donation of Mageweave
objectives: {'type': 'item', 'id': 4338, 'target': 'Mageweave Cloth', 'text': None}
completion: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, $N!

7846.name: Recover the Key!
desc: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to kill Hitah'ya the Keeper to get the Shackle Key to his bindings. Return to Elder Torntusk when you have recovered the key.
objectives: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to kill Hitah'ya the Keeper to get the Shackle Key to his bindings. Return to Elder Torntusk when you have recovered the key.
details: The key to my bindings is held by Hitah'ya the Keeper. She is in the nearby cave. Be careful, $c, for she is guarded well.
Kill her and bring the key back to loosen my shackles. Only then will I be free to return home.
completion: Freedom at last! Thank you, $N. Revantusk will know your deeds!

8062.name: Paragons of Power: The Predator's Bracers
desc: Bring the following Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub to Falthir the Sightless: A Primal Hakkari Bindings. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
Falthir the Sightless is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
objectives: Bring the following Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub to Falthir the Sightless: A Primal Hakkari Bindings. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
Falthir the Sightless is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
details: In the dark times after the fall of the Gurubashi Empire, Zandalar predators used their prowess to provide sustenance for the tribe. Hunters claim to be much like our tribe's predators - to seek the hunt is to embody the essence of the predator, yes. Your hunt in Zul'Gurub, however, will show us how you truly rate amongst our finest predators.
Bring to me a sampling of the Paragons of Power from within Zul'Gurub. Do so, and you'll take first steps in becoming the penultimate predator.
completion: Yes... I need no vision to sense the presence of the Paragons of Power. Your success in Zul'Gurub has impressed many among the tribe. We not only consider you to be a friend of the Zandalar, but also consider you worthy enough to possess the predator's bracers - powerful items, and a symbol of what it means to be a predator. Well done, $N.

8110.name: Enchanted South Seas Kelp
completion: See this here seaweed, mon? It be from the South Seas. We just add a little mojo and a little magic and it takes on the properties most suited to its owner.
You a $c so it be easy, mon. Just wrap it around your neck and think of nature or squirrels or whatever it be that you people like.

8158.name: More Resource Crates
desc: Win the battle for Arathi Basin, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Sergeant Maclear at Refuge Pointe.

8182.name: The Hand of Rastakhan
desc: Speak with Molthor in Stranglethorn.
objectives: Speak with Molthor in Stranglethorn.
details: $N, our worst fears have come. Legend speaks of the Soulflayer ruling the ancient troll world through evil and terror, and his power was absolute. If he cannot be stopped now, then his new reign may spread across all of Azeroth!

There is a contingent of Zandalarian trolls who may help us stem this tide of darkness. They have camped on Yojamba Isle, off the coast of Stranglethorn, west of the ruins of Zul'Kunda. Speak with their leader, Molthor, and pray he knows how to defeat Hakkar.
completion: You were sent by the prospector, Ironboot? His kind are wise, and wiser still to bring you to me, for I and the Zandalarian trolls may know a way to defeat the Soulflayer.
Speak with the trolls of this isle, heed their words, and prepare yourself, $N, for the task before you is soaked in blood.

8254.name: Cenarion Aid
desc: Seek out Ogtinc in Azshara.
objectives: Seek out Ogtinc in Azshara.
details: It is the way of the divine to help those in need. The how is insignificant -- only the why matters.
The Cenarion Circle has such a need. Speak with Ogtinc to lend aid to their plight. He resides atop the cliffs to the northeast of the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara.
completion: Your arrival has lifted a weight from my shoulders. We have much to do.

8278.name: Noggle's Last Hope
desc: Beetix Ficklespragg at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to gather 3 Stonelash Pincer Stingers, 3 Stonelash Flayer Stingers and 3 Rock Stalker Fangs.
objectives: Beetix Ficklespragg at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to gather 3 Stonelash Pincer Stingers, 3 Stonelash Flayer Stingers and 3 Rock Stalker Fangs.
details: Blasted! The antidote didn't work. Noggle must've been stung by one of the stronger creatures in the far south.

I'm going to need you to go there and get me some more samples, $N. The good news is that since their poison is stronger I won't require as many. The bad news is that there are more kinds of poisonous creatures crawling around the southern area so you'll have to draw from more sources.
completion: Yes! It seems to be working, Noggle is coming to. We owe ya big time!

8302.name: The Hand of the Righteous
desc: Collect 200 Silithid Carapace Fragments and return to Baristolth.

8374.name: Claiming Arathi Basin
desc: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
objectives: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
details: Winning a war is about more than just outsmarting and outfighting your opponent. Victory often comes down to simply producing more than your enemy.
What we have in Arathi Basin is a sizeable supply of resources for whichever side manages to claim it first.

If the Alliance comes out victorious, it'll mean more swords and pikes for our troops. If the Horde were to win, those swords and pikes would still get made, they'd just be pointed at us! Now is the time to help the Alliance in Arathi Basin, $N.
completion: Good work, soldier! Keep it up and we'll have the Horde running all the way back to Orgrimmar.

8398.name: Claiming Arathi Basin
desc: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.

8422.name: Trolls of a Feather
desc: Bring a total of 6 Voodoo Feathers from the trolls in sunken temple.
objectives: Bring a total of 6 Voodoo Feathers from the trolls in sunken temple.
details: My pet is almost done. Now I just need something to stuff it with.
Only the voodoo feathers from the trolls in the sunken temple will do. They go by the names Gasher, Mijan, Zolo, Hukku, Zul'lor, and Loro. Kill them. Kill them all.
This is no trivial task $n, so I'll make it worth your while by giving you something of Niby's -- he probably doesn't need it anyhow.
completion: Wonderful, now my pet is complete!
B<Impsy quickly stuffs the doll and gives it a demonic hug.>
Oh, what an odd side effect these voodoo feathers have...

8446.name: Shrouded in Nightmare
desc: Find someone capable of deciphering the meaning behind the Nightmare Engulfed Object.
Perhaps a druid of great power could assist you.
objectives: Find someone capable of deciphering the meaning behind the Nightmare Engulfed Object.
Perhaps a druid of great power could assist you.
details: Corruption seeps from this object.

There may be a link between this object and the dragons coming forth from the Dream. You must find someone that can decipher the meaning of this item. Perhaps the druids of the Moonglade or Cenarion Hold could assist you further.
completion: I must remove the taint from this object. This may shed some light on my recent failures to delve into the Dream. Give it to me.

8470.name: Deadwood Ritual Totem
desc: Take the Deadwood Ritual Totem inside Timbermaw Hold and see if one of the furbolgs there will find a use for the item. The Timbermaw will not speak with you unless you are of Neutral reputation or greater with them.
objectives: Take the Deadwood Ritual Totem inside Timbermaw Hold and see if one of the furbolgs there will find a use for the item. The Timbermaw will not speak with you unless you are of Neutral reputation or greater with them.
details: You have found one of the Deadwood furbolg's ritual totems. The totem itself is of non-descript construction, but a palpable sense of despair emanates from it. If there were any object that might best exemplify the corruption that the Deadwood furbolg suffer under, this item would clearly be it.
One of the furbolgs inside Timbermaw Hold may have a use for such an item... that is, if you've earned their trust enough for them to speak with you.$B
completion: This totem... I recognize it as one of the Deadwood's, but it is thick with the stench of decay. Whatever foulness has turned our brethren against us is surely present in this object.

You were wise to bring this to us, $N. Perhaps through study and ritual, we can uncover what it is that pollutes the minds of our brethren. Thank you, friend please accept these offerings in exchange for your find.

8494.name: The Alliance Needs Iron Bars!
desc: Bring 20 Iron Bars to Corporal Carnes at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
objectives: Bring 20 Iron Bars to Corporal Carnes at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
details: Well hello there, $g Mr. : Ms.; Fancypants, aren't you a sight for sore eyes. In case you hadn't heard while you were out there "adventuring", the Alliance has been gearing up for a war in Ahn'Qiraj and is in need of iron bars... a whole mess of 'em. Bring them to me in stacks of twenty. We can count on you, right, $c?
completion: Well, well, if it isn't $N. And you pulled through. I guess now I'll have to keep my eye on you. It hurts me to say this, but thanks for your efforts. The Alliance won't forget, and neither will I. Now get out there and bust your hump on whatever else needs collecting.

8518.name: The Alliance Needs More Linen Bandages!
desc: Bring 20 linen bandages to Sentinel Silversky at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8542.name: The Horde Needs Tin Bars!
desc: Bring 20 Tin Bars to Grunt Maug at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring 20 Tin Bars to Grunt Maug at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
details: Lok'tar, $r, I'm sure you already know that we're going to war at Ahn'Qiraj with the insects. But first the Warchief has decided that we're going to do something called 'prepare'. Though I'd rather be sharpening weapons and hammering armor into shape, I'm proud to have been chosen to be in charge of tin bar collection here. But I cannot do that without your help.
So I need you to go out and make tin bars and bring them back to me here. I think I'm going to need more than I can count.$B
completion: You have my sincere gratitude. Your efforts in helping Cenarion Hold have shown true courage.

8590.name: The Horde Needs Thick Leather!
desc: Bring 10 Thick Leather to Sergeant Umala at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring 10 Thick Leather to Sergeant Umala at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
details: I'm glad that you decided to speak to me about this, $c. It looks like the Horde's preparations for the upcoming Ahn'Qiraj War are in full swing. But you and I still need to do our part.

I've been asked to collect a great number of thick leather skins for use in all manner of war materiel, and I need you to help me by going out there and gathering them up. There's honor and the gratitude of the Horde in it for you should you decide to help. Will you?
completion: Good work, $C. I'm sure that these thick leather skins will be put to use reinforcing zeppelins and making all manner of armor and weaponry. You have my thanks, and that of the Horde. Come back again if you come across more thick leather in your travels, and luck be with you.

8614.name: The Horde Needs More Spotted Yellowtail!
desc: Bring 20 Spotted Yellowtail to Fisherman Lin'do at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.

8638.name: Deathdealer's Vest
desc: Bring the the Carapace of the Old God, 2 Idols of Strife, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Vethsera inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Honored reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

8662.name: Doomcaller's Circlet
desc: Bring Vek'nilash's Circlet, 2 Idols of Death, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

8686.name: High Mountain the Elder
completion: Your spirit burns with life, young $C. I accept the homage you pay, and offer in return this token...

8710.name: Kris of Unspoken Names
desc: Bring 1 Qiraji Ornate Hilt, 2 Onyx Idols, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Warden Haro in Silithus. You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
objectives: Bring 1 Qiraji Ornate Hilt, 2 Onyx Idols, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Warden Haro in Silithus. You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
details: The Qiraji and their servants wield items made with the rarest and finest materials: bones from gargantuan ancient creatures, gems from the depths of the earth, metals pure and strong.

Just the sight of Qiraji artifacts fills me with an urge to practice my craft with their shattered and smelted pieces. Prove your allegiance to the Circle, $N, and I will make you a powerful weapon from the finest Qiraji materials.
completion: You've done well, $C. This is a masterwork hilt... the balance is perfect.
Take your weapon, $N. Wield it with great confidence and vanquish our enemies!

8734.name: Tyrande and Remulos
desc: Travel to the Moonglade and speak to Keeper Remulos.
objectives: Travel to the Moonglade and speak to Keeper Remulos.
details: Tyrande will be notifed, mortal. Shan'do Stormrage has prepared me for this contingency.
Now you must venture to the Moonglade and speak with Remulos. He will have further instruction as to the summoning of Eranikus.
We all wish you great luck.
completion: It would be impossible to pull Eranikus from the Dream should he refuse. His intentions, however, require him to enter our world. He seeks to destroy the living manifestation of Malfurion. To do this successfully would mean an end to one of the most powerful allies of the Dream. The Nightmare would wholly consume all that would remain should Malfurion fall...

8758.name: The Path of the Invoker
objectives: {'type': 'item', 'id': 21206, 'target': 'Signet Ring of the Bronze Dragonflight', 'text': None}
completion: Your rise amongst the rank of the Brood is most impressive, $n. May you never stray from the path of the invoker!

8782.name: Uniform Supplies
desc: Bring 1 Mooncloth, 2 Bolts of Runecloth and 1 Ironweb Spider Silk to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing VIII in order to complete this quest.

8806.name: Grinding Stones for the Guard
desc: Bring 10 Dense Grinding Stones, 10 Solid Grinding Stones and 10 Heavy Grinding Stones to Vish Kozus, Captain of the Guard at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing III in order to complete this quest.

8902.name: Dearest Elenia,
desc: Deliver the Lovingly Composed Letter to Elenia Haydon near the bank in the Undercity.
objectives: Deliver the Lovingly Composed Letter to Elenia Haydon near the bank in the Undercity.
details: A lifetime ago, I was betrothed to marry Elenia, my childhood sweetheart. It's been years since I thought about her last, but of late, she frequently occupies my thoughts.
Perhaps, even with everything that has passed, there can be some room in each other's lives for our love.
I'm sure she has changed, also. Can you deliver this letter to her for me? I am too nervous to give it in person.
completion: This brings back memories from a lifetime ago, $N. Elenia Tor. That was going to be my name, you know. We would have a beautiful ceremony out on the shores of the lake. When he retired, we'd find a farm to retire to.
Simple dreams, then.
But if he saw me now, I doubt he'd even see Elenia in me. Only cold flesh and a dead heart...

8926.name: Just Compensation
desc: Bring a Wildheart Belt and a set of Wildheart Gloves Deliana in Ironforge.
objectives: Bring a Wildheart Belt and a set of Wildheart Gloves Deliana in Ironforge.
details: You kept your word and brought the device built by Mux. I believe a reward is in order if I'm to keep you interested in saving my skin. Bring me the belt and set of gloves that you wish to upgrade. I promise the ones I give you in return will be far superior.
completion: You've kept your end of the bargain, I shall keep mine.
Just remember that I'm holding on to the best pieces until your work is finished.

8950.name: The Instigator's Enchantment
desc: Bring the following to Falrin Treeshaper inside Dire Maul: 1 Jeering Spectre's Essence, 4 Dark Runes and 8 Large Brilliant Shards.
objectives: Bring the following to Falrin Treeshaper inside Dire Maul: 1 Jeering Spectre's Essence, 4 Dark Runes and 8 Large Brilliant Shards.
details: I can place the enchantment you require on the banner quite easily, $N. Unfortunately I don't have the materials I need as it is very rarely that someone asks for this sort of charm.

I will require the essence of one of the Eldreth ghosts that haunt these halls, a handful of Scholomance dark runes and some large brilliant shards. Bring me these reagents and I shall perform this task for you.
completion: Yes, these will do just fine. After I'm done, no force in the world will be able to stop your victim from accepting your challenge.

8998.name: Back to the Beginning
desc: Speak with Mokvar at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.
objectives: Speak with Mokvar at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.
details: I suppose that this is goodbye then, my friend. But, I'll always be here if you want to come back and talk with me from time to time. Probably while you're loitering around waiting for your buddies to join you for a raid on Blackrock Spire.
Go, before I start to cry. Go back to Mokvar in Orgrimmar and tell him what's happened.
completion: I am pleased to see that you have survived, $N. You look well, if not a bit more seasoned.
Come, tell me of all that has transpired.

9022.name: Anthion's Parting Words
desc: Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Boots of Valor, Legplates of Valor and Spaulders of Valor.
objectives: Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Boots of Valor, Legplates of Valor and Spaulders of Valor.
details: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.

The only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the amulet back together. Return to Mokvar and tell him that Bodley is his only hope for finding the remaining pieces. Speak to him about any rewards you've arranged for.
I, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
completion: This curse was bestowed upon us but for a mere medallion. Lord Valthalak certainly knows how to hold a grudge.
We'll endeavor to find the remaining pieces - hopefully before I meet an untimely demise. But before that, let us see about your reward.

9046.name: Redemption Spaulders
desc: Commander Eligor Dawnbringer at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a pair of Redemption Spaulders if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Spaulders, 12 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 2 Arcanite Bars and 2 Nexus Crystals.

9070.name: Earthshatter Headpiece
desc: Rimblat Earthshatter at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make an Earthshatter Headpiece if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Headpiece, 15 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 4 Arcanite Bars and 2 Nexus Crystals.

9118.name: Bindings of Faith
desc: Father Inigo Montoy at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Bindings of Faith if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Bindings, 6 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 1 Arcane Crystal and 1 Nexus Crystal.

9190.name: Craftsman's Writ - Runecloth Boots
desc: Deliver 8 Runecloth Boots and the Craftsman's Writ - Runecloth Boots - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

9238.name: Glacial Wrists
desc: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 4 Frozen Runes, 2 Bolts of Runecloth, 2 Essences of Water, 2 Ironweb Spider Silks and 200 gold.
objectives: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 4 Frozen Runes, 2 Bolts of Runecloth, 2 Essences of Water, 2 Ironweb Spider Silks and 200 gold.
details: Thanks to you and Omarion, may he rest in peace, I am now able to create Glacial wrists. All you need to do is bring me the materials and pay a small crafting fee.
completion: Here is your order, $N. Delivered as promised!

9262.name: Investigate the Scourge of Darnassus
desc: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Darnassus and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.
objectives: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Darnassus and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.
details: The Lich King has sent his undead upon our very doorstep; we cannot remain idle! Surely you will step up to defend Darnassus from these accursed invaders? $B $BThere are strange runic circles outside, glowing with the same energy that surrounds the undead and the Necropolis above. They have significance, I'm certain, and I want you to find out what. Thin the numbers of those aberrations while you're at it; bring me proof of their death along with your results, and I will reward you. Go!
completion: Hmm. From what you've told me, the voices within the circles... they must be used for communication of some kind. I shudder to think what unnatural minds are contacted through such magic. Regardless, you seem to have emerged whole and sane. The Argent Dawn appreciates your service.

9310.name: Faint Necrotic Crystal
desc: Bring the Faint Necrotic Crystal to Lieutenant Rukag in the courtyard of the Undercity.
objectives: Bring the Faint Necrotic Crystal to Lieutenant Rukag in the courtyard of the Undercity.
details: On the corpse of the fallen wight, you find a crystal that is faintly radiating necrotic energy.
completion: You say this was taken from a wight attacking the city?
We have received word about the necropolis base camps that are being summoned by the Scourge. I suspect they were trying to create one in the Undercity. We will have to be vigilant in the future.

objectives: Speak to the residents of Bandarion Keep.
* Speak with Hilda the Breaker
* Speak with Jorin Croge
* Speak with Ander Solliden
* Speak with Danitha Morr
details: Now that the immediate threat of the murloc attacks is under control, I'd encourage you to show yourself around our stronghold. It isn't much yet, but it's home.
When you are done exploring, seek out Danitha Morr, our leader. She can help you get settled in.
I'm very glad to have met you, . May the light be your guide.
progress: Welcome to Bandarion Keep, <class>. It's always good to see a new face.

objectives: Gather 3 Murloc Eyes for the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall.
* Murloc Eye#Classic (3)
details: Wow, my very first potion! Did you know that mixing those two herbs together would change the potion to a bright red color when you first started?
That was fun, but mixing a few flowers doesn't seem like the kind of alchemy Daddy does. He uses other ingredients too.
I don't know what else to use, so let's try the first thing that comes to mind! Let's see... maybe murloc eyes? That sounds so gross, but I bet something will happen.
progress: Don't worry about me, I'm a big girl. I can take care of myself. Just don't tell anyone I am hiding here, it's our little secret.

92422.name: The Wrath of Rath'mael
details: Reports have come in from the Lordamere Overlook deep within the Ruins of Lordaeron. An unholy fog has taken over the streets and graveyard, affording the scourge up there some measure of stealth.
Our scouts indicate they're being conjured by a new power within their ranks, a necromancer known as Rath'mael. We do not have the luxury of waiting this one out, <name>.
If you have allies, summon them and their aid to the Forsaken. Drive this creature out of our lands.
objectives: Kill Rath'mael in the  for Deathguard Kristof in Brill.
*Rath'mael slain
completion: While I have no doubt something of his kind will be replaced, we can only hope their ranks thin in the meantime.
Thank you <name>.
progress: Has the skeletal lieutenant been slain?

objectives: Slay 8 Ursera Scavengers and collect the head of the den mother, Urs'anah in Thendal Grove.
*Ursera Scavenger slain (8)
*Head of Urs'anah
details: Rorian informed you that I've been watching you. I now offer you a test of resolve. However, be warned--it will send you into great danger.

Go to the caves to the south. Thin out the ursera's numbers there, and find their matriarch, one the rangers call "Urs'anah". Put her down and bring me proof of her demise. Once you have done that, you will have taken an important step on your path.
progress: What I ask of you is not easy, but you must be prepared for much greater challenges if you are to survive long enough to be of service to Zephras Isle.

objectives: Speak with Halaan Hawk-Eye and borrow his gift to view the anchor pylon in the distance.
*View the Anchor Pylon
details: Greetings, young . I often times come here to look upon the ancient anchor pylon. Gifts from the spirits of the winds, they bind and sustain our island. Of late however, their magic has grown unstable and inconsistent.
They suffer no distress I can see. Their splendor has not changed.
If you'd like, I can lend you my gift to look upon them yourself.
progress: My gift is simple, and mundane. I cannot peer between worlds such as those with the skysight, nor can I draw upon the magic of the ley lines beneath Zephras like others can. But a gift it remains and I am grateful to have it.
Appreciation of what you have is the key to happiness. Yearning for what you may have, or what you have lost, only leads to despair.

objectives: Take the Symbol of Life and use it to resurrect Deathguard Falgan at Venomweb Vale.
Should you misplace your Symbol of Life, return to Danitha Morr for a replacement.
*Take the Symbol of Life and use it to resurrect Deathguard Falgan at Venomweb Vale.
details: Falgan and I were sent on a mission to scout out scarlet activity in Venomweb Vale. We managed to sneak close enough to one of their camps to hear about new orders involving an attack on Brill. Before we could decide what to do next, I stepped on a twig and the noise alerted them to us.
Falgan yelled at me to run, so I ran. By the time I realized he wasn't with me, I was halfway to Brill. That brave idiot probably stayed behind to hold them off for me.
Please, find my friend and help him if you can.

objectives: Collect 6 Savannah Lion Hides from the Savannah Matriarchs and Savannah Patriarchs in the .
* Savannah Lion Hide (6)
details: I need someone with a strong sword arm and some extra time on their hands to help me gather some lion hides. It stings my pride to ask a stranger for this aid, but I took an injury to my leg recently. Until I heal, I'm in no shape to go hunting myself but I have obligations to keep.
The big ones in this area generally have the best hides, so start with those first.

objectives: Visit Borstan's Firepit and tell him Thatog wants you to deliver Migi's lunch to him personally.
details: My son, Migi, always takes off to play with his friends all day. I tell him to pick up a lunch at Borstan's, but I know he almost never does, because he comes home starving. These kids think their games are more important than their own bodies!
Please, stop at Borstan's Firepit and tell him you're there to deliver Migi's lunch. You can almost certainly find Migi behind Grommash Hold with the rest of his friends.
Duties keep me here during the day and I can't watch over his every meal.

objectives: Bring Shelene Rhobart 8 Duskbat Wing Membranes, 6 Darkhound Hides and 3 Vile Fin Murloc Skin.
*Duskbat Wing Membrane (8)
*Darkhound Hide (6)
*Vile Fin Murloc Skin (3)
details: One part of undeath no one mentions is what happens when we are injured. How does the skin of an undead heal itself?
Well, it doesn't.
Ours is a cursed life, . We must take from the living to further our own existence.
When we sustain an injury, we must replace our skin which usually means animal hides. Since different hide thicknesses are better for different places on our bodies a variety is key!
Bring me wing membranes of a duskbat, hides from a darkhound and skin of a Vile Fin murloc.
progress: Have you gathered the skin I inquired about? Our stocks are running low.
It may seem odd to ask for murloc skin but it works well for internal membranes, or surfaces like cheeks or mouths.
Similarly, the duskbat wing membranes are especially suited for more delicate areas, like faces or fingers. It prevents the skin from being too... thick.

objectives: Collect 5 Tomb Weed and deliver them back to Junior Apothecary Holland.
* Tomb Weed (5)
details: If you're heading east, towards the Balnir Farmstead, I have more you might do for me. Good help is ever so hard to find these days, as your run-in with Gordo illuminates ever so clearly.

As I acquire doom weed I perform some minor alchemical alterations and replant them on that farmstead to cultivate my ultimate creation. I call it tomb weed, and it shall be the herald of my glorious destiny.
Do keep an eye on the Scourge in the area while you're there. They seem... drawn... to the weed. Curious.
progress: More interruptions! Wait, it's you. Were you able to recover the tomb weed?
